# Copilot entry

Copilot may load this file together with `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and
`GEMINI.md` in no fixed order, so it states no rule of its own. Read
`AGENTS.override.md` at the repository root, the compact, self-contained
cold-clone entry, and use its task router before opening papers, Lean source,
generated indices, or the deep `AGENTS.md` contract.

`AGENTS.md` remains authoritative for change order and validation once the
compact route has selected a lane. No Copilot instruction file, memory, sibling
checkout, or private-system path is proof or publication authority.
